responsibility: Implements the main AVX2 intrinsic header for x86, exposing the 256-bit integer/vector API associated with AVX2. It conditionally enables the avx2 target feature and defines a large collection of inline wrappers and macros for packed integer arithmetic, packing/unpacking, permutes, shifts, gathers, comparisons, and related operations by mapping the published intrinsic names onto GCC vector expressions and x86 builtins.
